children: New Delhi, Oct. 11 -- Moving beyond dividends, who doesn't like something special. Certain companies go a little extra and reward their shareholders with not just regular payout, but special dividends too. These additional payments are often announced against the backdrop of exceptional earnings, asset sales or accumulated cash surplus.

Over the last one year Tata Consultancy Services, JSW Dulux, Indo Borax & Chemicals, Majestic Auto, and Honda India Power Products have announced special dividends, in addition to their regular payouts. Here are all the details about the same.
JSW Dulux had announced Rs.156 per equity share, with a face value of Rs.10 each, last year in July 2025. The special dividend boosted the company's total dividend payout to Rs.236 per share in FY26.
The company stock closed 0.48% higher at Rs.3003.70 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.13,678.94 crore on Friday. The stock has declined 9% in one year, and 31% in two years.

Indo Borax & Chemicals had announced Rs.30 per equity share dividend in FY26, which made its total annual payout at Rs.40 per share. The stock closed 1.75% lower at Rs.475.50 per share on BSE. Its share price value has surged 87% in six months, 100% in one year, 132% in two years, and 202% in three years.
Premco Global had announced a special dividend of Rs.36 per equity share with a face value of Rs.10 each in FY26. The stock has announced a total of Rs.44 per share dividend in FY26.
The stock closed 0.85% higher at Rs.390 per share on BSE on Friday, October 9. Its share price value has declined 12.2% in one year, 11.97% in two years, and 5.8% in three years.
The company had announced Rs.35 per equity share special dividend in FY26, which took its total annual dividend payout at Rs.40 per equity share.

Majestic Auto share price value closed 2.81% lower at Rs.363.50 per share on BSE on Friday, October 11. The auto stock has delivered 5.36% return in one year, -17.17% return in two years, and around 100% return in three years.

The auto ancillary company had announced Rs.10 per equity share of special dividend, Honda India Power stock closed 0.47% lower at Rs.1832.60 per share. The stock has declined 32% in one year and 57% in two years.
Tata Consultancy Services had announced a special dividend of Rs.46 per equity share in January 2026. Which took its total dividend payout at Rs.110 per equity share in FY26.

The IT services giant has announced special dividend over the last three financial years. The IT stock closed 4.23% higher at Rs.2163 per share on BSE on Friday. Its share price value has 11.80% in one year, and 11% in two years.
